reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E3 shows graphene interfaces block cracks and stimulate dislocations in HEA composites, but not coherent metallic interlayer interfaces or creep. E1 and E2 discuss monolithic HEA deformation and creep mechanisms without addressing multilayer interfaces or their effect on dislocation climb.
premises: Multilayer interfaces in HEAs can block dislocation motion
Blocking dislocations delays creep by impeding climb and dynamic recovery
Coherent, chemically distinct interfaces are effective barriers
Monolithic HEA coatings serve as a valid baseline with identical composition
The mechanism dominates where dislocation climb and recovery are rate-limiting
